description.name: Entry
description.text:
ATK/MAG/DEF/RES -50% to all targets; grants [ATK/MND +50%, DEF +30%] and [Instant Cast 2] to party; grants [Crystal Force Mode] to user
Crystal Force Mode: Quick Support & Zero Hone Cost to Support Abilities
Crystal Force I/II: Grants [Deadly Strikes +30% 2] & [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 2] to party, Instant Cast, grants [200% ATB 1] to user

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions

description.name: Deadly Strikes +30% 2
description.text: Critical hits deal 30% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient and other Critical Damage statuses)

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 2
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next two attacks

description.name: 200% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x2.00
